en.title: Frequently Asked Questions
en.body:
Find answers to common questions about our products, services, and policies.

**General Questions:**

**Q: What types of jewelry do you offer?**
A: We offer a wide range of gold and diamond jewelry including rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and custom designs.

**Q: Do you provide certification for your jewelry?**
A: Yes, all our diamond jewelry comes with proper certification from recognized gemological laboratories.

**Contact Support:**
If you don't find the answer to your question here, please contact us at support@srimuruganjewellers.com or call +91 9876543210.
